create_Sam2Processor: create a Sam2Processor instance with an image processor, target size, and point pad value
call_Sam2Processor: call Sam2Processor to process images with input points, labels, and bounding boxes for SAM2 inference
normalize_Sam2Processor_coordinates: normalize SAM2 input coordinates to a target size preserving original aspect ratios
pad_Sam2Processor_inputs: pad nested lists of points, labels, and boxes to consistent dimensions for batched SAM2 inference
post_process_Sam2Processor_masks: post-process SAM2 output masks by removing padding and upscaling to original image sizes
